source: Binance USDT-M (fapi.binance.com, data.binance.vision): BTCUSDT open interest at each day’s open (the 23:55 UTC reading before it) and 7-day funding; alt share = share of USD open interest among the top 50 USDT-M alts by USD open interest (equity perpetuals left out) whose last funding settled that day was negative, from data.binance.vision daily metrics (USD open interest at the day close) and monthly funding files, so it runs to the end of last month (approximates Coinalyze top-300)
